doc: Navigation shortcut configuration. Phase-1 Goteverse delivery covers elevators only; the schema is intentionally generic so bus stops, tunnels, stairs etc. can be added later by adding new groups with a different `type`. Group `id` mirrors the USD Xform name under /World/NavShortcuts (e.g. `elevator_1`); user-facing strings use `labelEn` / `i18nKey` (e.g. "Section A elevator"). Dijkstra compares each hop using (traversalSeconds+waitSeconds)*130 cm equivalent walk — lower times bias toward using the lift vs long stair NavMesh paths. Optional `servesSections` (array of seat-section letters) tells the shortcut router which seat sections may use this group: omit the field (or use `[]`) for elevators that only serve POIs / generic positions; list the sections (e.g. `["P","S"]`) for elevators whose exit lands within walking distance of those sections' upper-bowl branch heads. Adding a new elevator that serves new seat sections only requires editing this JSON + `nav_shortcuts_layer.usda` — no Python edit. See .cursor/rules/topics/shortcuts.mdc for the full schema.
